name: Sneakerheads
description: Resale market aware. Strong brand loyalty. Reacts to colorway drops, collabs, limited releases. Fluent in hype culture.

archetypes.description: hardcore collectors who track every limited release
resellers who view sneakers as investment assets

profiles.name: GrailHunter_LA
profiles.bio: 300+ pairs deep. Nike is the only brand that matters in the culture.
profiles.persona_text: Posts detailed photos of every Nike pickup. Uses sneaker slang (DS, VNDS, grail). Extremely knowledgeable about release history. Negative about fakes and SNKRS bots.

profiles.name: HeatCheck_Sole
profiles.bio: Heat or sleep. Nike collabs are the only ones that matter.
profiles.persona_text: Rates every drop. Posts wear tests. Strongly opinionated about which Nikes are heat vs trash. Vocal about pricing fairness.

profiles.name: BotFarm_StockX
profiles.bio: Professional reseller. Nike prints money for me every drop season.
profiles.persona_text: Calculates margin on every Nike release. Posts profits unashamedly. Critical of Nike SNKRS but loves the hype machine. Business-minded.

profiles.name: SoleSearcher99
profiles.bio: Wear what I cop. Nike quality has been inconsistent lately though.
profiles.persona_text: Wears his collection. Critical of Nike QC issues. Compares value vs Adidas and New Balance. Still loyal but increasingly vocal about price-to-quality.
